conventions.availability: param identifies the actor argument, or is null for a global behavior. types lists allowed own UnitTypeId names; with param=null it is an any-of prerequisite filter. ALL imposes no static type restriction and includes structures. conditions are additional human-readable runtime checks, not implemented filter code; type membership alone does not guarantee execution.
conventions.params: type uses shared_types.json names and generic/union syntax. required is independent of input and nullability; false means the Ares default permits omission. All model parameters, including optional ones, are part of this exported interface.
conventions.runtime: input is model or runtime. Runtime parameters declare a fixed value or a registered source identifier. default is the Ares constructor default; value is an explicit agent policy override.
conventions.defaults: Set and tuple defaults use JSON arrays and must be reconstructed using type. Mutable defaults are fresh per instance. default_python preserves the upstream Nydus bool/tuple mismatch without presenting it as a valid boolean.
conventions.scope: Catalog consumed by the action runtime. llm_exposure controls model visibility; input controls the parameter provider. Disabled actions remain available to trusted internal callers.

entries.name: AMoveGroup
entries.description: Attack-move a group toward a target.

params.name: group
params.description: Units we want to control.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: Set of tags of the units in group; must match group.

params.name: target
params.description: Attack-move target.

entries.name: GroupUseAbility
entries.description: Use one ability with a group of units.

conditions: Every group member supports the selected ability; readiness is handled according to sync_command.

params.name: ability
params.description: Ability we want to use.

params.name: group
params.description: Units we want to control.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: Set of tags of the units in group; must match group.

params.name: target
params.description: The target for this ability.

params.name: sync_command
params.description: (default=True) If True, wait for all units to be ready before trying ability.

entries.name: KeepGroupSafe
entries.description: Avoid danger; attack when safe. close_enemy may be [].

conditions: Every group member can move on the selected grid.

params.name: group
params.description: Units we want to control.

params.name: close_enemy
params.description: Nearby enemy.

params.name: grid
params.description: Grid we should check for safety.

params.name: attack_in_range_enemy
params.description: Whether to attack in range if weapon is ready.

entries.name: PathGroupToTarget
entries.description: Path a group toward a target.

conditions: Every group member can move on the selected grid.

params.name: start
params.description: Where to start the path query.

params.name: group
params.description: The actual group units.

params.name: group_tags
params.description: Set of tags of the units in group; must match group.

params.name: grid
params.description: 2D grid to path on.

params.name: target
params.description: Target destination.

params.name: distance_check_squared
params.description: Distance check squared.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: If the unit has gotten this close, consider the path behavior complete.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: Path precision.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: Whether to smooth out the path.

params.name: sense_danger
params.description: Whether to check for dangers.

params.name: danger_distance
params.description: If sense_danger is True, how far to check for dangers.

params.name: danger_threshold
params.description: Influence at which a danger is respected.

params.name: prevent_duplicate
params.description: Whether to try to prevent spamming actions.

params.name: target
